<panel>
	<name>DAlphaBar</name>
	<parent>DPanel</parent>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<file line="">lua/vgui/dalphabar.lua</file>
	<description>A bar to select the opacity (alpha level) of a color.</description>
	<overrides>
		<page>Panel:Init</page>
		<page>Panel:Paint</page>
		<page>Panel:OnCursorMoved</page>
		<page>Panel:OnMousePressed</page>
		<page>Panel:OnMouseReleased</page>
	</overrides>
</panel>


<example>
	<description>Creates a DAlphaBar on a DFrame sets its value to 25%.</description>
	<code>
local frame = vgui.Create( "DFrame" )
frame:SetSize( 300, 500 )
frame:Center()
frame:MakePopup()

local DAlphaBar = vgui.Create( "DAlphaBar", frame )
DAlphaBar:SetPos( 20, 30 )
DAlphaBar:SetSize( 25, 125 )
DAlphaBar:SetValue( 0.25 )
DAlphaBar.OnChange = function( self, newvalue )
	print( "DAlphaBar value changed to " .. newvalue )
end

frame:MakePopup()
	</code>

</example>
